headline: The update fixes copy errors and makes trial wording clearer across the home and pricing pages.
what_changed: The home page now fixes spelling errors and describes searching scanned pages more clearly.
Calls to action now say “Start your free trial” on the home and pricing pages.
The pricing page fixes spelling and clarifies that the free trial lasts 14 days.
good_news: This is a small, contained wording-only change with no effect on prices, payments, customer data, or sign-up links.
